public.landingTagline: One login. Your whole gym. Nothing hidden.
public.landingSub: Members, plans, GST invoices, UPI payments, check-ins and WhatsApp renewal reminders - all in one place, built for independent gyms.
public.featureMembersDesc: Enrol once, renew in seconds, always know who is active and who is expiring.
public.featureBillingDesc: Tax invoices with SAC, CGST/SGST or IGST, amount in words, and a PDF your CA will accept.
public.featureUpiDesc: Collect by UPI with a QR, or cash/card. Partial payments and balances are tracked for you.
public.featureWhatsappDesc: Today's due messages in one list. Tap, send, mark sent. No per-message fees.
public.featureCheckinDesc: See who is in the gym right now, and who tried to check in without a valid plan.
public.featureReportsDesc: Revenue, expiries and check-in trends. Import your existing members from a CSV.
public.pricingSub: One price. No per-member fees. No per-message fees. Cancel any time.
public.gstNote: Price is all-inclusive of GST. One account, one gym, one owner.
